sections.kicker: Prepared for POSH Pocket Shoes by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram and your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: POSH has sixteen years of craft. The site opens with a sentence that could belong to any shoe brand.
sections.keep: The workshop story. "16 years of Marikina craftsmanship" is the line that only POSH can say.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.quote: This is what makes our everyday.
pins.what: The first words on the site are about style, not about POSH.
pins.why: Classics, comfort and minimal design describe any shoe label, so a visitor sees shoes, not a maker.
pins.how: Open with the workshop and the people who make each pair.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Shoppers compare POSH with shoes at any price in a mall.

pins.quote: Wish I was able to take photos of all of the custom pairs that we make
pins.what: Made to order is the strongest thing POSH does, and it hides in a highlight.
pins.why: Almost nobody makes your own colour and your own leather at this size, which answers why POSH and not the shop next door.
pins.how: Make custom pairs the way the brand introduces itself.
pins.label: Your highlights
pins.cost: The best reason to choose POSH is a small circle most visitors scroll past.

pins.what: The bio points to two other brands.
pins.why: Posh, Posh Everyday and Brethren Heritage compete for the same attention.
pins.how: Decide which name carries the story and how the others relate to it.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Followers are not sure which brand they are following.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at POSH Pocket Shoes. I spent some time on what people see first. Three things stood out.
